items.title: Google’s $15bn India data centre project faces water and environmental challenges
items.summary: Google’s planned $15bn data centre hub in Andhra Pradesh, India, is facing growing opposition from environmental activists over water use and its proximity to wildlife habitat, even as construction at the site moves ahead.

items.title: All surface water in England polluted by chemicals
items.summary: All bodies of water across England contain pollutants and toxic chemicals, according to new government data that found that less than 15% of surface water has achieved ‘good’ status for ecology.

items.title: 台灣用電需求增 彭啓明有信心：2030減碳28%有望達標 | 中央廣播電臺
items.summary: 您使用的瀏覽器版本較舊，已不再受支援。建議您更新瀏覽器版本，以獲得最佳使用體驗。環境部長彭啓明今天(7日)表示，台灣最新國家自定貢獻(NDC 3.0)將2030年減碳目標由24%提高至28±2%，未來每年減碳幅度更提高至4%至5%，挑戰相當大，但環境部認為，2030年目標仍在既定渠道上，甚至有機會提前達標。

items.title: Google Purchases Entire Output from RWE U.S. Solar Project
items.summary: German power producer RWE announced that it has signed a 15-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Google for the entire output from a new 155 MW solar project in Oklahoma.

items.title: EU Eases CORSIA Carbon Credit Rules Amid Supply Crunch
items.summary: The European Commission is easing carbon credit requirements for airlines covered by the first phase of CORSIA, responding to a severe shortage of eligible units.

items.title: ABB Invests in LevelTen to Expand Clean Energy Deals
items.summary: ABB is expanding its clean energy services through a strategic partnership and minority investment in LevelTen Energy, the US-based clean energy marketplace.

items.title: Ore Energy Raises $43M to Scale 100-Hour Batteries
items.summary: Ore Energy has raised $43 million to scale iron-air batteries designed to tackle a growing problem for Europe’s power system.

items.title: US Republicans Target California Emissions Rules
items.summary: Four Republican U.S. senators have proposed repealing California vehicle emissions rules that have shaped automotive regulation well beyond the state.

items.title: Norway Fast-Tracks Onshore Wind and Grid Expansion
items.summary: Norway is moving to accelerate onshore wind and electricity grid development as rising power demand puts pressure on one of Europe’s most renewable electricity systems.

items.title: India Targets 1 Million Tons of New Green Ammonia
items.summary: India is preparing another major expansion of domestic green ammonia supply as it moves to reduce fertiliser producers’ dependence on imported fossil fuels.
